description: This file defines classes for logging statistics, including a base logger, a dummy implementation, and a StatsD client-based implementation, with conditional import handling.

classes.name: BaseStatsLogger
classes.description: Abstract base class for real-time event logging with methods to increment, decrement, record timing, and gauge metrics.

classes.name: DummyStatsLogger
classes.description: A dummy implementation of the stats logger that logs debug messages instead of sending metrics.

classes.name: StatsdStatsLogger
classes.description: A statsd client implementation that sends metrics to a statsd server, with fallback if the statsd package is not installed.

methods.name: incr
methods.description: Increments a counter (abstract in base, implemented in subclasses).

methods.name: decr
methods.description: Decrements a counter (abstract in base, implemented in subclasses).

methods.name: timing
methods.description: Records a timing metric (abstract in base, implemented in subclasses).

methods.name: gauge
methods.description: Sets a gauge metric (abstract in base, implemented in subclasses).
